title: A lazy batch iterator
summary: Group any iterable into lists of a fixed size, with an optional drop_last, without loading the whole input into memory.

mutants.eager_copy: Copies the whole input into a list first, so it reads every item before the first batch.
mutants.ignores_drop_last: Always yields the short last batch, even when drop_last is True.
mutants.reuses_buffer: Yields one list object again and again and clears it, so earlier batches change.
mutants.no_validation: Accepts a batch size below 1 and returns no batches.
